BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers berserker
BackstoryDef.description: While [PAWN_nameDef] was a fairly low ranking member of the Sea Vipers, [PAWN_pronoun] was quite well known for [PAWN_possessive] combat prowess. Preferring to dual wield axes, [PAWN_nameDef] would frequently enter a battle frenzy, showing complete disregard for any life threatening wounds [PAWN_pronoun] may be suffering from.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers brigand
BackstoryDef.description: As a lowly brigand, [PAWN_nameDef] was simply one of many in the Sea Vipers. Equiped with a two handed weapon and leather armor, [PAWN_possessive] survival in raids was entirely dependent on [PAWN_possessive] skills, which must have been been reasonably alright.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers butcher
BackstoryDef.description: Once a former pirate, [PAWN_nameDef] decided to enlist into the Sea Vipers, and hopefully fight for a good cause for once. Things didn't qutie turn out as [PAWN_nameDef] had hoped, as [PAWN_pronoun] had quickly regressed to setting buildings aflame.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers charger
BackstoryDef.description: While not overly skilled with magic, [PAWN_nameDef] did know how to channel lightning through [PAWN_possessive] maul, creating impacts that left anyone nearby both literally and figuratively shocked. This talent earnt [PAWN_nameDef] a place in the Sea Vipers, though didn't exactly earn [PAWN_objective] a high rank.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers cutthroat
BackstoryDef.description: Due to being rather light on [PAWN_possessive] feet, [PAWN_nameDef] was often sent into enemy camps before the rest of the Sea Vipers arrived. [PAWN_possessive] sole purpose, to take down a few key members, and then slip into the shadows.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers duelist
BackstoryDef.description: Always quick on [PAWN_possessive] feet, [PAWN_nameDef] would glide throughout the battlefield, swiftly taking down anyone that got in [PAWN_possessive] way.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_possessive] was used to taking a beating, and put [PAWN_possessive] experience to good use in the Sea Vipers. [PAWN_nameDef] would take on large groups all by [PAWN_objective]self, letting [PAWN_possessive] allies regroup and continue the assault.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers marine
BackstoryDef.description: As a rather high ranking soldier in the Sea Vipers, [PAWN_possessive] was one of the marines sent in to finish the assault. Sometimes this was after the initial attack had weakened their target, and sometimes [PAWN_nameDef] was the initial attack.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers strongarm
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was among some of the more feared members of the Sea Vipers. Even on the off chance [PAWN_pronoun] was disarmed, [PAWN_nameDef] would just continue onwards, crushing anyone in [PAWN_possessive] path.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers sharpshooter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was well known for [PAWN_possessive] keen eyee, and steady hands. These two traits made [PAWN_possessive] an obvious pick for the Sea Vipers, who were in dire need of archers. [PAWN_nameDef] would be taking down targets before the others were even ready to launch the assualt.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers vanquisher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was equally skilled with both short blades and javelins, which made [PAWN_objective] quite an asset to the Sea Vipers. Anyone trying to run away, and alert anyone else nearby, would quickly fall to the ground, with a javelin buried in their back.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers healer
BackstoryDef.description: There were always many injured Sea Vipers at the end of a battle, and [PAWN_nameDef] would always try to tend to them all, no matter the state they were in.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers mender
BackstoryDef.description: As a rather skilled restoration mage, [PAWN_nameDef] was an invaluable asset to the Sea Vipers, as an unsuccessful raid on Summerset would result in many casualties.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers serpent lord
BackstoryDef.description: The Sea Vipers made great use of sea serpents during battles, and [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the many in charge of them. A highly important job, as an enraged sea serpent didn't particularly care which ship it went after.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers pyromancer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a rather skilled fire mage, that was quite fond of the smell of wood burning. A rather dangerous combination when at sea, but a deadly one during a battle. [PAWN_nameDef] would keep [PAWN_objective]self busy setting things on fire, while the other Sea Vipers were taking down anyone putting up a fight.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers tempest
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] would send bolts of lightning flying whenever the battle began. While [PAWN_pronoun] would often miss, the loud shocks of each impact would cause a great deal of confusion, giving [PAWN_possessive] fellow Sea Vipers a nice advantage.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers chillrender
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef], as a somewhat skilled ice mage, would create large walls of ice, seperating groups of foes, allowing [PAWN_possessive] fellow Sea Vipers to easily take them down.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers commander
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] commanded a small band of soldiers, whose sole task was to undertake ground assaults, while the Armada kept the main enemy forces distracted. [PAWN_nameDef] took great pride in [PAWN_possessive] soldiers work, and always treated them to a nice meal afterwards, no matter the outcome.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers captain
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef], started off captaining a pirate crew, a crew which made quite a name for itself. Eventually [PAWN_pronoun] caught the eye of the Admiral of the Sea Vipers, and was given the opportunity to join the Armada, retaining full control of [PAWN_possessive] ship and crew in the process. [PAWN_nameDef] quickly accepted, under a few conditions of course.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Vipers commodore
BackstoryDef.description: Many moons ago, [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the commodores of the Sea Vipers. [PAWN_pronoun] commanded several ships in the Sea Vipers, and was considered quite a tactical genius. Sadly even [PAWN_possessive] intellect wasn't enough to capture Summerset, and [PAWN_nameDef] wound up stepping down after yet another failed invasion.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks deckhand
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had always wanted to join the Storm Sharks, in hopes that [PAWN_pronoun] would get the opportunity to travel to exotic locations, and to meet interesting people. Most days were simply spent docked at one of the many harbors in Pyandonea, the rest were filled with unfathomable bloodshed.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks lightningfang
BackstoryDef.description: With a preference for dual-wielding shortblades, [PAWN_nameDef] was quite the formidable foe during raids. [PAWN_pronoun] went through the same ritual before each battle, which involved covering [PAWN_possessive] blades in void salts. [PAWN_nameDef] believed this granted [PAWN_objective] luck, in reality it just gave everyone he sliced open electric shocks.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks striker
BackstoryDef.description: While [PAWN_nameDef] did serve as heavy infantry in the Storm Sharks, [PAWN_possessive] main purpose was to keep the leviathans in check, as they had a tendency of getting slightly carried away..

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks archer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the many archers found in the Storm Sharks. [PAWN_possessive] sole purpose was to provide support for [PAWN_possessive] fellow soldiers.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks chanter
BackstoryDef.description: Most restoration mages took upon themseves an oath to help anyone in need of it. As Maormer, [PAWN_nameDef] made no such oath, and simply provided healing to [PAWN_possessive] fellow soldiers.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks beast master
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was rather skilled at controlling beasts, a skill that was simply invaluable to the Storm Sharks. What [PAWN_pronoun] wasn't entirely used to however, was controlling Maormer leviathans, which proved substantially more difficult for [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks wavepriest
BackstoryDef.description: As a somewhat skilled snake mage, [PAWN_nameDef] controlled quite a few reef vipers during [PAWN_possessive] time in the Storm Sharks. These beasts proved to be dealy weapons, far deadlier than most of the recruits.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks windcaller
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] would use [PAWN_possessive] knowledge of air magic to herd unbound storm atronachs towards [PAWN_possessive] foes. This required the utmost concentration, as one mistake could force the atronach towards [PAWN_possessive] fellow Storm Sharks instead.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks commander
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] commanded a small band of soldiers, whose sole task was to undertake ground assaults, while the Armada kept the main enemy forces distracted. [PAWN_nameDef] took great pride in [PAWN_possessive] soldiers work, and always treated them to a nice meal afterwards, no matter the outcome.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks captain
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent countless moons training at the academy, and countless more serving as a low ranking crewmember. Eventually, [PAWN_nameDef] got the promotion [PAWN_pronoun] had worked so hard for, [PAWN_nameDef] had finally become one of the captains of the Storm Sharks.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm Sharks admiral
BackstoryDef.description: Once the admiral of the Storm Sharks, [PAWN_nameDef] was well respected by [PAWN_possessive] peers. Even if the raids on Summerset never turned out how [PAWN_pronoun] wanted, [PAWN_nameDef] never gave up. Eventually though, all the successive failures were simply to much for [PAWN_possessive] peers to ignore, and [PAWN_nameDef] resigned from [PAWN_possessive] position.

BackstoryDef.title: Maormer colonist
BackstoryDef.description: We watched [PAWN_nameDef] grow into an adult. [PAWN_possessive] story is still being written.

BackstoryDef.title: psychically gifted
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born with a greater awareness of the unseen. After many years of mentoring by some of the highest ranking snake priests, [PAWN_pronoun] learnt how to harness [PAWN_possessive] gift, and hear the voices of the serpents.

BackstoryDef.title: magically attuned
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born with a greater control over magicka than most. After many years of tutoring by some of the highest ranking snake mages, [PAWN_pronoun] learnt how to harness [PAWN_possessive] gift.

BackstoryDef.title: snake tamer
BackstoryDef.description: Every aspiring sea serpent tamer had to start somewhere, and for [PAWN_nameDef], that was taming plain old snakes. [PAWN_pronoun] struggled at first, and may have been bitten a few times, but eventually [PAWN_nameDef] got the hang of handling them.

BackstoryDef.title: crab herder
BackstoryDef.description: The Isles of Pyandonea were home to many crab farms, and [PAWN_nameDef] assisted at one of them. The crabs found there weren't particularly intelligent, as one would expect, but always seemed to find holes in the pen. [PAWN_nameDef] spent many days chasing escaped crabs, and mending broken fences.

BackstoryDef.title: bug collector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had quite the exquisite collection of bugs, all found natively in Pyandonea. While Pyandonea was home to many colorful arthropods, there were far too many for [PAWN_objective] to collect, but that never stopped [PAWN_nameDef].

BackstoryDef.title: scallop digger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed to earn a bit of coin digging for scallops. Days were long and tiring, likely because [PAWN_nameDef] spent quite a considerable amount of time digging in the wrong places.

BackstoryDef.title: assistant cook
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] provided assistance to some highly skilled cooks. While [PAWN_pronoun] learnt quite a few things, [PAWN_nameDef] didn't make it very far, as [PAWN_pronoun] really doesn't like plants.

BackstoryDef.title: assistant shipwright
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] provided assistance to the local shipwrights. [PAWN_nameDef] knew all the commonly used tools by heart, and eventually started handing them to the shipwrights before [PAWN_pronoun] was even asked to fetch it.

BackstoryDef.title: assistant smith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] provided assistance a rather skilled blacksmith Admittedly, [PAWN_nameDef] spent a substantial amount of time bandaging wounds, as [PAWN_nameDef] didn't quite seem to understand touching hot things was a bad idea.

BackstoryDef.title: healers assistant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] provided assistance to one of the healers at the local temple. From preparing poultices to brewing elixirs, [PAWN_nameDef] could attempt it, but not necessarily succeed at it.

BackstoryDef.title: pirate child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was practically born into the pirate life, and spent most of [PAWN_possessive] early years at sea. [PAWN_pronoun] picked up some useful skills, though most were focused on the best places to stab opponents.

BackstoryDef.title: kelp harvester
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made sure to always help during the kelp harvests. Admittedly, [PAWN_nameDef] just wanted to catch a glimpse of a sea serpent, maybe even touch one. Sadly, [PAWN_pronoun] never did.

BackstoryDef.title: coral enthusiast
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was always fascinated by coral, especially all the different shapes and colors it came in. [PAWN_nameDef] even spent most of [PAWN_possessive] spare time reading about all the different species of coral that grows elsewhere.

BackstoryDef.title: embassy assistant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was dragged to one of the many Maormer embassies by [PAWN_pronoun] parents, so it was only natural that [PAWN_pronoun] wound up as an assistant. Most days were spent organising scrolls and wardening guests, though ocassionally something exciting happened.

BackstoryDef.title: temple assistant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] assisted at the local temple. This usually involved sweeping the floor, and ensuring candles were in good condition. But sometimes [PAWN_nameDef] would be tasked with organising the library, or leading guests around.

BackstoryDef.title: merchants assistant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] assisted one of the many local merchants. Days were spent hauling crates of various goods around, reparing said crates when [PAWN_pronoun] dropped them, and occasionally working the counter.

BackstoryDef.title: sea adder tamer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was rather skilled at taming sea adders. Admittedly this wasn't exactly something to brag about, as sea adders are far more manageable than the larger reef vipers, but [PAWN_nameDef] didn't really care.

BackstoryDef.title: reef viper tamer
BackstoryDef.description: Even when reared in captivity, reef vipers are rather aggressive, and only those with a skilled touch are able to tame them. [PAWN_nameDef] was one such person, and even then [PAWN_pronoun] has nearly lost fingers a few times.

BackstoryDef.title: reef viper handler
BackstoryDef.description: The Maormer were well known to employ the use of reef vipers when raiding Summerset, and [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the many in charge of handling them in the field. While being taken down by a reef viper is quite a terrifying experience, it's nothing compared tending the vipers wounds afterwards.

BackstoryDef.title: crab rancher
BackstoryDef.description: Many kinds of crab could be found on Pyandonea, many of which were farmed for meat. [PAWN_nameDef] worked at a small family owned crab ranch down by the coast. While most of [PAWN_possessive] times was spent in the fields, quite a bit was also spent in the kitchen.

BackstoryDef.title: pearl diver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] decided to earn a living diving for pearls. This was easier said than done, as most of the reefs were home to sea serpents. But eventually [PAWN_nameDef] would find enough to make jewellery out of.

BackstoryDef.title: sep adder tamer
BackstoryDef.description: While most Maormer chose to work with sea adders or reef vipers, assuming they wished to work with serpents at all, [PAWN_nameDef] decided to work with sep adders. Unlike the native serpents of Pyandonea, sep adders aren't exactly used to Maormer, and don't much care for being prodded with sticks. [PAWN_nameDef] learnt this the hard way, yet still [PAWN_pronoun] persevered.

BackstoryDef.title: thunderbug rancher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked at a small thunderbug ranch. While the meat and chitin of thunderbugs were worth a decent amount, [PAWN_nameDef] was mostly interested in their hearts, and often experimented with them in [PAWN_possessive] spare time.

BackstoryDef.title: wasten coraldale mudcrab farmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked at one of the finest crab ranches on Pyandonea, for this one specialised in the Wasten Coraldale Mudcrab. The meat of the Wasten Coraldale Mudcrab is considered quite the delicacy by the Maormer, and [PAWN_nameDef] most certainly sampled some whenever possible.

BackstoryDef.title: sea serpent tamer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was among the most skilled tamers to be found on Pyandonea. While most tame sea adders and reef vipers, [PAWN_nameDef] tamed sea serpents, some of the largest, and most ferocious, serpents around.

BackstoryDef.title: slaughterfish breeder
BackstoryDef.description: One day [PAWN_nameDef] decided [PAWN_pronoun] wanted to rule the seas. Of course for most Maormer, plans such as these would involve forming a pirate crew, or taming a particularly large sea serpent. [PAWN_nameDef] decided to take [PAWN_possessive] plans for oceanic domination in a slightly different direction, and started breeding slaughterfish. Eventually the swarm grew so large that there was no containing it. A few days later [PAWN_nameDef] recieved word that one of Orgnum's prized sea serpents had been devoured. [PAWN_nameDef] took the first ship [PAWN_pronoun] could find.

BackstoryDef.title: dock builder
BackstoryDef.description: Pyandonea had a great need for docks, and [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the many that helped fulfil that need.

BackstoryDef.title: shipwright
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the many shipwrights found on Pyandonea, a profession that was always in demand there. Maormeri ships are quite unlike any other, for they are constructed out of chitin instead of wood. Of course this difference in building technique didn't make it any easier for [PAWN_nameDef].

BackstoryDef.title: foreman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ordered around all of the shipwrights, who in all honestly were rather clueless as to the process of building a ship. [PAWN_possessive] time at work was exhausting, but [PAWN_nameDef] did consider it worthwhile, as there was always a fine vessel waiting at the end of it all.

BackstoryDef.title: scallop farmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] owned a small scallop farm back on Pyandonea. Admittedly the scallop were incredibly easy to look after, and [PAWN_nameDef] actually spent most days cooking.

BackstoryDef.title: fire salts cook
BackstoryDef.description: While [PAWN_nameDef] wasn't exactly the best cook out there, [PAWN_pronoun] did know how to cook using fire salts, and this made [PAWN_objective] invaluable on long voyages.

BackstoryDef.title: fisher
BackstoryDef.description: While [PAWN_nameDef] worked a tiring job during the day, [PAWN_pronoun] enjoyed relaxing near the coast, and fishing for a while. Admittedly this wasn't actually that relaxing, as there was always the chance that a sea serpent lurking was lurking in the kelp.

BackstoryDef.title: wasten coraldale mudcrab chef
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] earnt quite a living cooking Wasten Coraldale mudcrab. [PAWN_possessive] dishes were considered some of the finest on Pyandonea, which [PAWN_nameDef] could most certainly attest to.

BackstoryDef.title: net maker
BackstoryDef.description: Nets were a highly in demand commodity on Pyandonea, and [PAWN_nameDef] took great advantage of it. [PAWN_pronoun] would always spread the many uses of nets to any potential customers, and even managed to gain the eyes of a few high ranking members of a pirate band.

BackstoryDef.title: smith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a rather skilled smith, and had produced many of the weapons used by the Maormeri Navy, and quite a few of the ones used by the various Maormer pirate groups. [PAWN_nameDef] didn't really care who made the orders, as coin is coin.

BackstoryDef.title: spy
BackstoryDef.description: As a both a spy and a Maormer, [PAWN_nameDef] couldn't just rely on words to achieve [PAWN_possessive] goals. [PAWN_pronoun] had to rely almost solely on [PAWN_possessive] wits, and what fine wits they were.

BackstoryDef.title: assassin
BackstoryDef.description: Sometimes all that was needed was a silent blade, that was when someone like [PAWN_nameDef] was called into action. [PAWN_nameDef] would silently climb the side of a ship, sneak into the targets quarters, and then vanish, back into the depths. No one on board any the wiser that that a crew member was no longer with them.

BackstoryDef.title: commander
BackstoryDef.description: As somewhat of a veteran, [PAWN_nameDef] had the privilege of commanding new recruits, ensuring they survive their first attempted invasion of Summerset, or at least returned in one piece.

BackstoryDef.title: serpent knight
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the famed serpent knights, highly skilled warriors that rode sea serpents into battle, with a little help from a nearby snake mage of course. Alas [PAWN_possessive] fighting days have been over for a while, as [PAWN_possessive] beloved serpent steed is sadly no more.

BackstoryDef.title: orgnium miner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] slaved away in one of the largest orgnium mines on Pyandonea. Many days were spent delving into the depths, searching for even the smallest traces of orgnium.

BackstoryDef.title: cavern excavator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] decided to take on the back-breaking work of excavating caverns. Not only did [PAWN_nameDef] need to be good with a pick, [PAWN_pronoun] needed to be good with a hammer too.

BackstoryDef.title: outpost miner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked at one of the many mines the Maormer had set up in off the coast of Valenwood, with the goal of finding precious minerals. Tensions were always high, as [PAWN_nameDef] and his fellow miners didn't exactly have permission to be there, and at any second arrows could start raining down from between the trees.

BackstoryDef.title: treasure hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an aspiring treasure hunter, which meant [PAWN_pronoun] spent most days digging around in the sand, hoping to find something worth anything. [PAWN_nameDef] did find a few sea serpent scales, and some Altmer bones, but that was about it.

BackstoryDef.title: kelp farmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was in charge of one of the many kelp forests surrounding Pyandonea. Kelp was pretty easy to grow, and [PAWN_nameDef] didn't really need to do anything except keep an eye on it. However, harvesting it was an entirely different matter.

BackstoryDef.title: coral grower
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew for exotic species of coral for a living. There were so many different colors, and shapes, and [PAWN_nameDef] cared for each one equally.

BackstoryDef.title: outpost lumberer
BackstoryDef.description: Good quality wood was somewhat in demand in Pyandonea, and one of the closest places to get it just happened to be Valenwood. So [PAWN_nameDef], and many others, set up logging outposts in Valenwood. quite the risky decision, as Bosmer are quite fond of their trees. Unsurprisingly, [PAWN_possessive] time there didn't last very long, as they were quickly driven back to Pyandonea by the Bosmer.

BackstoryDef.title: alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had extensive knowledge of the plants that grow on Pyandonea, and their alchemical uses. While this knowledge could have been used for certain nefarious purposes, [PAWN_nameDef] was mostly interested in providing aid wherever possible.

BackstoryDef.title: Thrassian coral cultivator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed to obtain a truly rare species of coral, one that could only be found on the Thrassian Archipelago. [PAWN_nameDef] treasured that little coral, as if it were [PAWN_possessive] own child. But it never managed to grow very large, likely because it longed for its homeland.

BackstoryDef.title: hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always enjoyed the calm of going out into the wilderness, and tracking one of the beasts found there. Pyandonea was home to some strange creatures, and while [PAWN_nameDef] was never scared, the thought of encountering a lizard bull did make [PAWN_objective] nervous.

BackstoryDef.title: merchant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had made several deals with local ship crews, [PAWN_pronoun] purchased their goods, and sold them for a sizeable profit. [PAWN_pronoun] really didn't care where the goods came from, and was well aware that several of the crews [PAWN_pronoun] made deals with were pirate bands.

BackstoryDef.title: diplomat
BackstoryDef.description: Occasionally the Maormer did conduct diplomacy, and when they did they would need someone with a sharp tongue, such as [PAWN_nameDef]. [PAWN_pronoun] had to be good, as being a Maormer [PAWN_nameDef] was always at a disadvantage.

BackstoryDef.title: serpent priest
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the many serpent priests, and was almost as good at communicating with serpents as [PAWN_pronoun] was with Maormer. This proved useful when dealing with those with waning faith.

BackstoryDef.title: prophet of Satakal
BackstoryDef.description: Many believed Satakal spoke directly through [PAWN_nameDef]. Of course this was considered somewhat heretical, as how could Satakal speak through [PAWN_nameDef] if he already speaks through Kind Orgnum. Needless to say, [PAWN_nameDef] eventually decided it was best to lay low for a while.

BackstoryDef.title: air mage
BackstoryDef.description: Born with an affinity towards the storm, [PAWN_nameDef] quickly mastered control over air, and eventually became a highly skilled air mage. [PAWN_nameDef] created impenetrable vortexes of wind, sending anyone caught within flying into the sea.

BackstoryDef.title: lightning mage
BackstoryDef.description: Born with an affinity towards the storm, [PAWN_nameDef] quickly mastered control over lightning, and eventually became a highly skilled lightning mage. [PAWN_nameDef] rained bolts of lightning at [PAWN_pronoun] foes, and took no prisoners.

BackstoryDef.title: water mage
BackstoryDef.description: Born with an affinity towards the storm, [PAWN_nameDef] quickly mastered control over water, and eventually became a highly skilled water mage. [PAWN_nameDef] would turn once calm water into a maze of waves, sending enemy ships plunging into the depths.

BackstoryDef.title: snake mage
BackstoryDef.description: While most scoff at the idea of a snake mage, those that have actually encountered one will rarely be found laughing. [PAWN_nameDef] had such great control over sea serpents, that [PAWN_pronoun] could sink entire fleets within seconds.

BackstoryDef.title: Blue Venom swashbuckler
BackstoryDef.description: While somewhat skilled with a blade, [PAWN_nameDef] was also somewhat knowledgeable about elemental salts, and made great use of this knowledge during skirmishes. [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the few survivors of the Blue Venom pirates, and is now in hiding, hoping one day to reconnect with the remainders of [PAWN_possessive] crew.

BackstoryDef.title: Blue Venom bounty hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had a knack for finding people that didn't want to be found, especially when there was a price on their head. This skill was rather invaluable for the Blue Venom pirates, and made up one of their main sources of income. [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the few survivors of the Blue Venom pirates, and is now in hiding, hoping one day to reconnect with the remainders of [PAWN_possessive] crew.

BackstoryDef.title: Blue Venom flame adept
BackstoryDef.description: Somewhat talented with magic, and ever obsessed with the flicker of flame, it was obvious that [PAWN_nameDef] would become a fire mage. This skillset proved rather useful for the Blue Venom pirates, especially if they needed evidence of their activities to disappear. [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the few survivors of the Blue Venom pirates, and is now in hiding, hoping one day to reconnect with the remainders of [PAWN_possessive] crew.

BackstoryDef.title: Blue Venom necromancer
BackstoryDef.description: Having a necromancer in your crew proved rather useful for the Blue Venom pirates. [PAWN_nameDef] ensured crew members were never truly lost in battle, and turned extended skirmishes into battles of attrition. [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the few survivors of the Blue Venom pirates, and is now in hiding, hoping one day to reconnect with the remainders of [PAWN_possessive] crew.

BackstoryDef.title: Dreadsails warrior
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a member of the Dreadsails, admittedly not entirely by choice, at least not anymore. What once seemed like a good idea, a pathway to fame, fortune and glory, [PAWN_nameDef] realised would simply lead to an early grave. Not that [PAWN_nameDef] would even be allowed to rest in death.

BackstoryDef.title: Dreadsails raider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lived for the battle, for the bloodshed, for the cries of pain. Or at least [PAWN_nameDef] thought [PAWN_pronoun] did. The longer [PAWN_pronoun] served on the Dreadsail, the more obvious it became that death was [PAWN_possessive] life now, and for eternity after.

BackstoryDef.title: Dreadsails sentinel
BackstoryDef.description: Once a guard at one of the many Maormeri embassies, [PAWN_nameDef] decided to turn to a life of piracy, as working conditions constantly grew worse. [PAWN_pronoun] joined the Dreadsails, which in hindsight was a terrible choice. Unbeknown to [PAWN_nameDef], [PAWN_pronoun] had entered a pact of lifelong servitude.

BackstoryDef.title: Dreadsails tempest
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a literal whirlwind on the battlefield, striking with both blades and magic, none could escape [PAWN_pronoun]. Which made [PAWN_nameDef] the perfect warrior for the Dreadsails.

BackstoryDef.title: Dreadsails captain
BackstoryDef.description: As both a highly skilled water mage, and a leviathan, [PAWN_nameDef] was the obvious pick for the captain of the Dreadsails, not that the crew really had a say. Many of the crew found it strange that a leviathan would have such an affinity water magic. However none dared bring this up when [PAWN_nameDef] was around.

BackstoryDef.title: Dreadsails queen
BackstoryDef.description: While the crew of the Dreadsails reported to their captain, there was in fact someone even higher up the food chain, [PAWN_nameDef]. Most of the crew didn't even dare whisper [PAWN_possessive] name, for the crew of the Dreadsails could be split into two main groups. Those that served willingly, and those that served for eternity.

BackstoryDef.title: Keel Cutter butcher
BackstoryDef.description: In all honesty, [PAWN_nameDef] just really enjoyed stabbing people, and was rather proficient at it. So proficient in fact that [PAWN_pronoun] easily became part of the Keel Cutters, and wound up becoming a sort of torturer for them.

BackstoryDef.title: Keel Cutter ravager
BackstoryDef.description: For [PAWN_nameDef], there was no better feeling in the world than the feeling of metal slicing through flesh. Luckily, life in the Keel Cutters provided ample opportunities for this.

BackstoryDef.title: Keel Cutter champion
BackstoryDef.description: Once an elite member of the Pyandonean Armada, [PAWN_nameDef] was stripped of [PAWN_possessive] position after an unfortunate incident. [PAWN_possessive] 'retirement' didn't last for long though, as [PAWN_nameDef] was quickly recruited by the Keel Cutters, who were rather impressed with the rumours they had heard.

BackstoryDef.title: Keel Cutter thundermaul
BackstoryDef.description: While [PAWN_nameDef] always had some slight magical skills, and a bit of an affinity towards lightning magic, [PAWN_pronoun] did also just enjoy smashing things with a big maul. The Keel Cutters didn't mind this, and in fact actively encouraged it, which made [PAWN_nameDef] feel right at home.

BackstoryDef.title: Keel Cutter archer
BackstoryDef.description: While the pirates of the Keel Cutters greatly preferred feeling someones limb separating from their body, some such as [PAWN_nameDef] liked to keep a respectable distance from their foes. This preference did come in handy when someone tried running away, while others would have to chase after them, [PAWN_nameDef] would just ready an arrow.

BackstoryDef.title: Keel Cutter vanquisher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always thought it was strange that [PAWN_pronoun] fellow Keel Cutters limited themselves so much. [PAWN_pronoun] knew that anyone with half a brain had a sword for stabbing people up close, and some javelins for anyone that tries to run away.

BackstoryDef.title: Keel Cutter mender
BackstoryDef.description: Pirates of the Keel Cutters were quite ruthless, and often wound up with several injuries after a skirmish. So they recruited [PAWN_nameDef], a reasonably skilled healer with no moral quandaries.

BackstoryDef.title: Keel Cutter sea lord
BackstoryDef.description: As a rather skilled storm mage, [PAWN_nameDef] commands a rather generous amount of respect. Sadly, [PAWN_pronoun] didn't quite feel respected enough in the Storm Sharks, and decided to set out on [PAWN_possessive] own. [PAWN_nameDef] wound up joining the Keel Cutters, who [PAWN_pronoun] made sure respected [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Keel Cutter captain
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once ruled the Keel Cutters with a lightning clad fist. Under [PAWN_pronoun] command the hauls were glorious, and the bloodshed exquisite. Though eventually [PAWN_nameDef] grew tired of the constant violence, and decided to gaze upon other shores by [PAWN_objective]self.

BackstoryDef.title: Wake Walkers blademaster
BackstoryDef.description: Always nimble on [PAWN_possessive] feet, [PAWN_nameDef] was a whirlwind of blades during combat. Those that escaped [PAWN_possessive] blades, would soon be felled by the beasts of the Wake Walkers.

BackstoryDef.title: Wake Walkers sentinel
BackstoryDef.description: Once a guard at one of the many Maormeri embassies, [PAWN_nameDef] decided to turn to a life of piracy, as working conditions constantly grew worse. [PAWN_pronoun] joined the Wake Walkers, which was a rather odd choice, as [PAWN_nameDef] was neither nimble nor good with animals.

BackstoryDef.title: Wake Walkers archer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wasn't content with just turning someone into a pincushion, [PAWN_pronoun] wanted to make them suffer a bit. Seeing as the Wake Walkers often utilised animals, coming across various venoms wasn't exactly an issue.

BackstoryDef.title: Wake Walkers mender
BackstoryDef.description: As a member of the Wake Walkers, [PAWN_nameDef] had to not only tend to [PAWN_possessive] fellow crew members, but also the beasts they fought alongside. Luckily [PAWN_pronoun] was used to dealing with animals, especially animals that didn't want to be dealt with.

BackstoryDef.title: Wake Walkers beastmaster
BackstoryDef.description: As a beastmaster, [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the most important members of the Wake Walkers, excluding the captain of course. [PAWN_pronoun] had assembled a small menagerie for use in combat, from giant snakes, to the ferocious haj mota.

BackstoryDef.title: Wake Walkers captain
BackstoryDef.description: There were many ways pirate captains could display their power, and [PAWN_nameDef] decided [PAWN_pronoun] wanted the largest beast [PAWN_pronoun] could find. So that's how [PAWN_nameDef] wound up with a pet haj mota.

BackstoryDef.title: Orgnum's royal guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once one of the elite, one of King Orgnum's personal royal guard. Skilled with both blade and magic, and with an affinity towards the sea serpents, [PAWN_nameDef] was a truly frightening sight on the battlefield.

BackstoryDef.title: wereshark hunter
BackstoryDef.description: There were many vile creatures found on Pyandonea, but none more vile than the wereshark. No one knows why, but [PAWN_nameDef] has dedicated [PAWN_possessive] life to exterminating them, no matter the cost.

BackstoryDef.title: sea serpent hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made quite a name for [PAWN_objective]self, though not entirely for the right reasons. [PAWN_pronoun] was a hunter, and lived for the feeling of blood washing over [PAWN_objective]. Eventually though, [PAWN_pronoun] grew tired of the regular foes, and sought out something far more dangerous, and somewhat heretical. [PAWN_nameDef] began hunting sea serpents. This obviously didn't go over well with most other Maormer. But [PAWN_pronoun] kept going, slaying every single one [PAWN_pronoun] came across, at least until Orgnum's Dragon Kights put a stop to it.

BackstoryDef.title: crab researcher
BackstoryDef.description: One dark and stormy night, [PAWN_nameDef] witnessed something truly unusual. A creature like no other, a bipedal crab, walking on land. The creature approached [PAWN_objective] slowly, and cautiously, all the while making a guttural gurgling sound. Then, as a bolt of lightning struck, it disappeared, leaving behind a strange pearl like object. Sadly [PAWN_nameDef] almost immediately lost the pearl, but still likes ponder the wondrous secrets it may have held.

BackstoryDef.title: master orgnium smith
BackstoryDef.description: Starting from a young age, [PAWN_nameDef] has apprenticed under some of the best smiths found on Pyandonea. Quickly surpassing [PAWN_possessive] mentors, [PAWN_nameDef] was tasked by King Orgnum himself to craft a new set of armor, an honor most never dreamed of. It's said the armor was strong enough to withstand the full might of a serpent's jaws, not that King Orgnum ever needed to worry about that.

BackstoryDef.title: master buoyant steel smith
BackstoryDef.description: Always obsessed with what lies beneath the waves, one day [PAWN_nameDef] learnt of buoyant steel, a strange magical alloy, far lighter than it had any right to be. Ever since then [PAWN_pronoun] has worked towards becoming a master at working buoyant steel. This proved to be difficult, as buoyant steel is not easy to come by, but eventually [PAWN_nameDef] got there, crafting a cuirass that rivalled ebony in quality.

BackstoryDef.title: master moonstone smith
BackstoryDef.description: One of [PAWN_nameDef]'s ancestors was a rather skilled moonstone smith, back when the Maormer were still Aldmer. Though some has been lost to time, this knowledge has been passed down the generations, eventually being passed to [PAWN_nameDef].

BackstoryDef.title: Pyandonea reef diver
BackstoryDef.description: Kelp beds around Pyandonea feed half the islands. [PAWN_nameDef] dove for them before learning to read, and came up with a healthy respect for what else lives down there.

BackstoryDef.title: serpent keeper's child
BackstoryDef.description: Sea serpents are not pets, as [PAWN_possessive] parent explained while feeding one. [PAWN_nameDef] learned to carry the bucket and never to run.

BackstoryDef.title: fog watcher
BackstoryDef.description: The fog around Pyandonea hides the islands from everyone but those raised in it. [PAWN_nameDef] sat on a rock calling out shapes for the harbor pilots.

BackstoryDef.title: serpent caller's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Snake magic starts with not being eaten. [PAWN_nameDef] spent long nights on the rocks with an old Serpent Caller, soaked through and told to pay attention.

BackstoryDef.title: Orgnum's temple page
BackstoryDef.description: King Orgnum has ruled for longer than anyone can check. [PAWN_nameDef] carried water in his temple and was told that asking how he does it was unwise.

BackstoryDef.title: deck child
BackstoryDef.description: Born aboard a raiding ship, [PAWN_nameDef] walked on a pitching deck before ever standing on land. Solid ground still feels slightly wrong.

BackstoryDef.title: wreck picker
BackstoryDef.description: Altmer ships founder on the reefs from time to time, and everything on them is free. [PAWN_nameDef] knew good Summerset silver by the weight.

BackstoryDef.title: coral carver's child
BackstoryDef.description: Living coral cuts the hands and heals badly. [PAWN_nameDef] carved it into small serpents anyway, and traders paid well for them.

BackstoryDef.title: net hauler
BackstoryDef.description: The catch comes in heavy and it comes in at dawn. [PAWN_nameDef] hauled nets with a line of cousins and could gut a fish without looking.

BackstoryDef.title: Satakal shrine sweeper
BackstoryDef.description: Old shrines to the world-eating serpent stand on the outer islands. [PAWN_nameDef] swept out the sand and listened to the priests disagree.

BackstoryDef.title: Altmer-hating child
BackstoryDef.description: Other children learned their letters. [PAWN_nameDef] learned the names of every Summerset admiral who had burned a Maormer town, and what should happen to them.

BackstoryDef.title: tide pool collector
BackstoryDef.description: Certain slugs found in the tide pools will stop a fever, and others stop a heart. [PAWN_nameDef] learned which was which from a very patient aunt.

BackstoryDef.title: harbor rat
BackstoryDef.description: Pirate towns have many dark corners, and a small child can fit in most of them. [PAWN_nameDef] heard plenty, and sold it for fish.

BackstoryDef.title: ship's boy turned gunner
BackstoryDef.description: A shipboard ballista needs someone quick to load it. [PAWN_nameDef] had the job at nine, and could judge range over water before losing the first milk teeth.

BackstoryDef.title: storm orphan
BackstoryDef.description: One bad season took the family boat and most of the family. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in an uncle's boathouse, mending what the sea left.

BackstoryDef.title: sail mender
BackstoryDef.description: Sailcloth has to be stitched tight or the wind finds it. [PAWN_nameDef] spent childhood bent over a seam, with very good eyes and a bad back.

BackstoryDef.title: snake charmer's helper
BackstoryDef.description: Reef vipers are smaller than serpents and far more likely to bite. [PAWN_nameDef] milked them for venom and has a numb finger to show for it.

BackstoryDef.title: Maormer noble's child
BackstoryDef.description: Pyandonea's great houses still follow Aldmeris's old manners, and resent that they do. [PAWN_nameDef] was taught both the manners and the resentment.

BackstoryDef.title: mist wall child
BackstoryDef.description: The mist around Pyandonea has kept outsiders lost for as long as anyone remembers. [PAWN_nameDef] rowed into the edge of it on a dare, and was found two days later going in circles.

BackstoryDef.title: sea-chant singer
BackstoryDef.description: Rowers need a beat and the chant gives it. [PAWN_nameDef] sang the high part on a war galley, and knows many words not fit for shore.

BackstoryDef.title: Tempest watcher
BackstoryDef.description: Sailors want to know when bad weather is coming, and a child with sharp senses can earn a meal telling them. [PAWN_nameDef] was usually right.

BackstoryDef.title: captive's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_possessive] mother was taken off an Imperial trader and stayed. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up speaking two languages, and was not fully trusted in either.

BackstoryDef.title: shell gatherer
BackstoryDef.description: Blue shell from the south beaches goes into dyes and fine inlay. [PAWN_nameDef] walked the tide line every morning with a basket and sharp eyes.

BackstoryDef.title: pirate's ward
BackstoryDef.description: A keel-cutter captain took [PAWN_nameDef] in, for reasons nobody ever quite explained. Lessons came with a cuff to the ear and a small sharp knife.

BackstoryDef.title: lighthouse child
BackstoryDef.description: The lamp on the point has to burn on nights nobody is expected. [PAWN_nameDef] climbed the stair at dusk and trimmed it, and watched for sails.

BackstoryDef.title: salt panner
BackstoryDef.description: Salt gets into the cracks of the hands and stays there. [PAWN_nameDef] raked the pans in the summer and traded the salt in the winter.

BackstoryDef.title: fish market child
BackstoryDef.description: Fish has to be sold before noon, and a loud child sells more. [PAWN_nameDef] could be heard across the harbor by the age of eight.

BackstoryDef.title: serpent egg thief
BackstoryDef.description: A serpent egg will fetch a fortune, and the mother will take your arm. [PAWN_nameDef] managed it once, on a dare, and has retold the story ever since.

BackstoryDef.title: pale-eyed seer child
BackstoryDef.description: Eyes with no color at all are thought lucky on some islands. Strangers kept asking [PAWN_nameDef] for fortunes, so [PAWN_pronoun] began making them up.

BackstoryDef.title: rope walker
BackstoryDef.description: Rope is spun by walking backward for hours. [PAWN_nameDef] walked backward through most of childhood, and still finds it oddly restful.

BackstoryDef.title: tidal farm child
BackstoryDef.description: Sea-weed beds are farmed just like fields, except they try to drown you. [PAWN_nameDef] tended them through hundreds of low tides.

BackstoryDef.title: raid survivor
BackstoryDef.description: Dominion marines burned the town to teach a lesson. [PAWN_nameDef] learned it, though not the one they had in mind.

BackstoryDef.title: whale butcher's child
BackstoryDef.description: When a whale beaches, the entire town comes down with knives. [PAWN_nameDef] went inside one at age seven, since small hands were useful.

BackstoryDef.title: navigator's pupil
BackstoryDef.description: Reading stars through fog takes practice and guesswork. [PAWN_nameDef] learned the guesswork first, and got good at sounding sure of it.

BackstoryDef.title: snakeskin brute
BackstoryDef.description: Born a leviathan, [PAWN_nameDef] was always one to lash out at anyone nearby, which the Storm Sharks put to great use. They trained [PAWN_nameDef] with a sword, and let [PAWN_objective] loose on the Altmer.

BackstoryDef.title: snakeskin berserker
BackstoryDef.description: The Storm Sharks put [PAWN_nameDef]'s animalistic nature to great use, they would just need to provoke [PAWN_objective] a little, and off [PAWN_pronoun] would go. Of course there was always a chance this would backfire, which is why [PAWN_nameDef] had several handlers to follow [PAWN_objective] around.

BackstoryDef.title: leviathan
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born slightly different to most, even by child standards [PAWN_pronoun] struggled to walk, and was far more at home in the water. Turns out [PAWN_nameDef] was born a Leviathan, which became incredibly obvious as [PAWN_pronoun] grew larger, far larger than any child should be. Also [PAWN_possessive] jaw distending when eating may have helped [PAWN_possessive] parents come to that conclusion.

BackstoryDef.title: avatar of Satakal
BackstoryDef.description: When [PAWN_nameDef] was born, it was apparent [PAWN_pronoun] was different. [PAWN_possessive] village believed [PAWN_pronoun] was an avatar of Satakal, and worshipped [PAWN_nameDef] as if [PAWN_pronoun] was a god. This was swiftly put to an end after Orgnum's Royal Guard visited [PAWN_possessive] village.

BackstoryDef.title: sea demon
BackstoryDef.description: When [PAWN_nameDef] was born, it was apparent [PAWN_pronoun] was different. [PAWN_nameDef] managed to escape from [PAWN_possessive] outpost when the Colovian armies began their attack. Forced to live in the wilds, [PAWN_nameDef] relied on pure animalistic instinct to survive. The inhabitants of nearby fishing villages thought [PAWN_pronoun] was a sea demon, and multiple times attempted to capture [PAWN_possessive].

BackstoryDef.title: snakeskin child
BackstoryDef.description: Thanks to being born as a Leviathan, the Storm Sharks took great interest in [PAWN_nameDef]. They began 'training' [PAWN_objective] as soon as [PAWN_pronoun] was able to walk. This took a great toll on [PAWN_nameDef], causing [PAWN_objective] to regress into an animalistic beast.

BackstoryDef.title: abandoned child
BackstoryDef.description: Born during an unfortunate time, [PAWN_nameDef] was quickly left to fend for [PAWN_objective]self. Luckily for [PAWN_nameDef], [PAWN_pronoun] was born as a Leviathan, and as such was fully capable of surviving the wilds.

BackstoryDef.title: serpent child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] heard a calling from the wilds one day, and decided to wander off in search of it. Completely lost, [PAWN_pronoun] eventually came across an ancient sea serpent, who took [PAWN_objective] in as if [PAWN_pronoun] were its own child. If [PAWN_nameDef] wasn't a Leviathan, [PAWN_pronoun] may not have been so lucky.
